title: filwallet
tagline: A simple desktop wallet build with javascript react electron filcoin wallet  with support to web3storage
description: A simple desktop wallet build with javascript react electron filcoin wallet  with support to web3storage ,A few months ago, I got some filecoin, needed a wallet to store the filecoins, as I didn't find any desktop wallet,I made my own wallet with web3storage support to upload files using the wallet on your computer
how_its_made: this project uses Reactjs,react-router to change the pages of the app, material-UI to create the interface and inputs, and electron to build the desktop app cross-platform, file coin js to create filecoin account, and send transaction and web3storagejs to upload files from your pc.
